svg.title: Spectre Brands VHS shell / black clean (V01 final)
svg.desc: 187 × 103 mm VHS top face, black, clean. Rear edge at top, front cover at bottom. Measured TDK geometry from the logos-tape2 base; flat moulding definition added (edges, chamfer, label recess walls, window bezels, knurled grip), light top-left. No filters, no wear.
